Damage Reports
Quick Guide

Log furniture damage in under a minute — just four quick steps. Find it in the main menu under Damages.

1
Open Damages
From the home screen, tap the Damages tile. Then tap the + button in the top right to start a new report.
2
Where did it happen?
Tap one of the four options — Pickup, Install, Transport, or Warehouse. The wizard moves to the next step automatically.
3
Type of damage
Choose what happened — Scratch, Dent, Broken leg, Broken top, or Tear.
4
Type of furniture
Select the affected piece — Sofa, Table, Chair, Rug, Storage unit, or Bedhead.
5
Take a photo
Use Camera to take a photo on the spot, or Library to attach an existing one. Tap Submit Report when done — or Skip photo & submit if no photo is available.
Tip: All reports are saved to the Damages page with the date, location, damage type, furniture, and photo thumbnail. Tap any photo to view it full size.
